changeLog.note: First registry (REV 16.1 Step 0). Moved every health threshold, schedule and safety wording out of Swift and index.html into this file.

Added the numbers behind Body Check: waist-to-height bands (NICE NG246) and the NHS half-height line, waist action levels (BMJ 1995), body-fat circumference method (US DoD), resting energy (Mifflin-St Jeor).

values.formula: weight in kg divided by height in metres squared

entries.meaning: Adult (20+) BMI category cutoffs shown beside the BMI read from Apple Health. A screening measure, not a diagnosis.
entries.note: Class 1/2/3 obesity splits (35, 40) exist at the source; the app shows one Obesity range.

entries.meaning: Global Solar UV Index exposure categories and their colour code, used for the widget's UV number, level word and colour.
entries.issuer: WHO / WMO / UNEP / ICNIRP (Global Solar UV Index)
entries.sourceVersionDate: Global Solar UVI 2002; Review workshop report 2017 (page undated)
entries.note: WHO's own Q&A (2022) groups the same scale into 0-2, 3-7, 8+ with advice; the five-band table is the global index. Hex values are the app's rendering of the official colour names.

entries.meaning: The ABCDE warning signs of melanoma shown on Findings when a spot has changed.
entries.note: The source describes D as usually greater than 6 mm; the app shows the word only and never states a size.

values.label: Monthly
values.shortText: Monthly is what the Skin Cancer Foundation recommends.
values.whyText: The Skin Cancer Foundation recommends a head-to-toe self-exam every month and a dermatologist full-body exam at least once a year.

entries.meaning: Default skin self-exam / scan reminder cadence and the wording that explains it.
entries.note: More frequent cadences in Settings (every 2 weeks, weekly) are the user's choice, not guidance.

entries.meaning: Professional full-body skin exam interval used for the yearly dermatologist reminder.
entries.note: The 2-week lead time before the anniversary is the app's own nudge, not guidance.

entries.meaning: Waist-to-height ratio bands for adults: healthy 0.4 to 0.49, increased 0.5 to 0.59, high 0.6 or more.
entries.note: NICE words the bands as central adiposity with no / increased / further increased health risks. The app shows only the band names plus the consult bar.

values.text: Keep your waist under half your height.

entries.meaning: The one-line waist-to-height advice shown with the ratio.
entries.note: NHS states: try to keep your waist size to less than half your height.

entries.meaning: Waist circumference action levels: at or above the first number, gain no further weight; at or above the second, reduce weight.
entries.issuer: BMJ 1995 (Lean, Han, Morrison): Waist circumference as a measure for indicating need for weight management
entries.note: Original peer-reviewed source of the 94/102 cm (men) and 80/88 cm (women) action levels; the NHS page no longer lists them.

entries.meaning: US DoD circumference body-fat estimate (Navy method): men = 86.010 x log10(waist - neck) - 70.041 x log10(height) + 36.76; women = 163.205 x log10(waist + hip - neck) - 97.684 x log10(height) - 78.387; measurements in inches (the app converts from cm).
entries.issuer: US Dept of Defense (Hodgdon & Beckett 1984; Hodgdon & Friedl 1999), as reproduced in Foulis et al., Frontiers in Physiology 2023
entries.note: An estimate. The same article reports circumference methods do not reliably capture small body-composition changes, so the app labels it an estimate and does not rate it.

entries.meaning: Mifflin-St Jeor resting energy: 9.99 x weight(kg) + 6.25 x height(cm) - 4.92 x age + 166 x sex (male 1, female 0) - 161, in kcal per day.
entries.issuer: Mifflin MD, St Jeor ST et al., Am J Clin Nutr 1990;51:241-247 (PubMed 2305711)
entries.note: A population estimate of resting energy use in healthy adults, not a measurement.

values.text: ALWAYS CONSULT WITH A LICENSED HEALTH CARE PROVIDER

entries.meaning: The standing safety bar shown on Findings (when something is flagged) and in Settings.
entries.issuer: The Body Guard (own safety wording, set by B Rad 2026-10-01)
entries.note: No external source to re-check; it is the app's own rule. Kept here so no health wording lives outside the registry.
